info.title: Access Online Transactions and Orders
info.description:
This service provides Access Online Transaction and Order details, specifically

- Read the details of a transaction
- Retrieve the attachments of a transaction
- Read the details of an order
- Find orders matching search criteria

Unless stated otherwise, strings allow the following special characters, including the 'space' character:

**` - = \ ] [ ' ; / . , ! @ # $ % & * ( ) _ + { } | : " ? < >**

Last updated Jan 26, 2026

get.description: Given a transaction ID, return the transaction details.

parameters.name: transactionID
parameters.description: The 29-digit Access Online Transaction Unique Identifier

get.description:
Given a transaction ID, return the transaction attachment as a PDF file. The maximum PDF file size is limited to 10MB.

The field **transactionInformation.hasAttachment** indicates whether an attachment is available.

The PDF file is returned as a byte array in the response. The contents should be saved to a file using the .pdf file extension.

If no attachment is available, 404 - Not Found is returned.

parameters.name: transactionID
parameters.description: The 29-digit Access Online Transaction Unique Identifier

200.description: Response is a PDF file attachment.

schema.example:
Content-Type: application/pdf
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename='12345678901234567890-11-2200003.pdf'
Content-Length: 12345
<PDF binary data stream>

get.description: Given an order ID, return the order details.

parameters.name: orderID
parameters.description: The 8 digit Access Online Order ID

post.summary: Find orders matching the search criteria.
post.description:
Find orders that match the specified search criteria.

One or more of the following search criteria can be provided in the request. Multiple search criteria form a logical conjunction, meaning they are joined via the **AND** operator. See the **SearchOrder** schema for details of each criterion.

- order amount range
- control number
- order date range
- expiration date range
- payment account ID
- recipient email
- order status
- order type

The search can include an order date range and/or an expiration date range. If neither is specified, the results will include order dates within the the last 90 days. Up to 6 years of order history are retained, with a maximum search range of 90 days.

If no search parameters are provided (empty request body), then all orders created within the last 90 days are returned.

The result is a list of one or more order summaries sorted by orderID in ascending order. If there are no matches, status 200 and page.totalCount of zero are returned.

The page number and size are specified in the request body. A page number of 1 indicates a new search. The page size and search criteria should not change in subsequent requests.

XXXDefaultError.description:
There are two error formats
1) Gateway errors
2) API service errors

**Gateway errors** are formatted per the *USB_ErrorGateway* schema. Common gateway errors are
- 401 - Access token has expired
- 429 - Too many requests
- 500 - Access token is invalid
- 503 - The service is temporarily unavailable
- 504 - Gateway timeout (API service has exceeded timeout period)

**API service errors** are formatted per the *USB_ErrorService* schema. The primary content of a service error is

- **code** - 3 part error code AAA.0709.CCCC
  * AAA = 3-Digit HTTP status code
  * 0709 = 4-Digit code assigned to this service
  * CCCC = 4-Digit reason code from the service

- **message** - a description of the error condition

Refer to the schema definition for optional detail possibly returned.

Following is a list of possible service errors, including a description and example. This list is not exhaustive and other errors may be returned.

- 400 Bad Request - The request format or parameters are invalid
- 403 Forbidden - The client is not authorized to access the requested resource
- 404 Not Found - The requested resource does not exist
- 405 Method Not Allowed - The requested resource does not support the requested method
- 406 Unacceptable - Accept header must be application/json
- 409 Conflict - Often indicates duplicate Idempotency-Key detected
- 415 Unsupported Media Type - Content-Type header must be application/json
- 500 Internal Server Error - The server cannot process the request due to an internal error

**NOTICE - The example values are approximate representations and not actual.  The example JSON structures are accurate, while some fields are optional.**

SearchAmount.description:
Compared to orderDetails.orderInformation.orderAmount

Specify an amount range within these limits -
- Providing only the minimum matches amounts >= minimum.
- Providing only the maximum matches amounts <= maximum.
- Providing both matches amounts inbetween inclusive.
- The minimum cannot exceed the maximum.

minimum.description: Indicates the minimum order amount, inclusive.

maximum.description: Indicates the maximum order amount, inclusive.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD indicates the lower limit of the date range, inclusive.

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD indicates the upper limit of the date range, inclusive.

number.description: The page number to return, 1 to N

size.description: The maximum number of items returned per page

allOf.description:
Compared to orderDetails.orderInformation.orderDate

Specify an order date range within these limits -
- The start and end dates are inclusive.
- The range cannot exceed 90 days.
- The start cannot exceed the end.
- The start can be up to 6 years in the past.
- *The end cannot be in the future.*
- If start is not provided, it defaults to 90 days before the end.
- If end is not provided, it defaults to 90 days after the start.
- If neither orderDate or orderExpirationDate is provided, the default date range is the last 90 days.

Specify an expiration date range within these limits -
- The start and end dates are inclusive.
- The range cannot exceed 90 days.
- The start cannot exceed the end.
- The start can be up to 6 years in the past.
- *The end can be up to 1 year in the future.*
- If start is not provided, it defaults to 90 days before the end.
- If end is not provided, it defaults to 90 days after the start.
- There is no default orderExpirationDate range. If not provided, it is not a search criteria.

USB_ErrorGateway.description:
Gateway error response.

The error code and message are primary error indicators, and the optional errors[] array contains additional details.

USB_ErrorService.description: API Service error response. Array of 1 or more error conditions. This is a common error structure used for most error responses, unless noted otherwise. Only the 'code' and 'message' fields are required. The example values are generic.

code.description:
3 part error code AAA.0709.CCCC
* AAA = 3-Digit HTTP status code
* 0709 = 4-Digit code assigned to this service
* CCCC = 4-Digit reason code from the service

details.description: Optional array indicating 1 or more fields in error
